comparison.objective: Open a scored ampoule while capturing its cap in a protective opener, versus collet-nut preassembly.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a brittle vessel and lever a scored neck to fracture inside a tool; candidate performs nondestructive eccentric-lip capture and snap seating.
comparison.success_condition: Ampoule body must remain upright and cap contained after separation; candidate requires intact retained assembly and no damage. Candidate snap-force limit is absent.
comparison.reason: Both retain a small component, but one tests protected fracture and the other precision assembly.
